# 2025 Holy Cross Crusaders football team

The 2025 Holy Cross Crusaders football team will represent the College of the Holy Cross as a member of the Patriot League during the 2025 NCAA Division I FCS football season. The Crusaders will be coached by second-year head coach Dan Curran and play at the Fitton Field in Worcester, Massachusetts.
